cards.h1: You asked the group chat to pick a date

cards.text: Six people reply any weekend suits me
Three of those six now have something on. All different weekends.
Someone makes a poll. Four people open it. Nobody votes.

cards.title: What actually works
rows: Put up three dates, not a blank box
Give the group 48 hours to vote
Book it before anyone reopens it

cards.text: A group chat can react to options. It cannot produce one.

cards.title: Frolic makes the call for you
cards.sub: Hens and bucks planning, start to finish
